title: Wild AG portrait and values
description: A staggered two-column about section on paper: gradient serif-italic title with three paragraphs of warm-grey text and a landscape photo below it on the left; a photo and then a second title with four values (bold title, short text, a short gradient hairline between) on the right. On phones it stacks text, photo, values, photo. The text fades up as it comes into view.
notes: two image slots, 16px corners; empty, plain sand placeholders at the original's 1.14 (desktop) / 1.33 (phone) frame
the value dividers reach 40px left of the column, as on the original
